intervals.label: construction (detector components being built and deployed)
intervals.locator: PANDA news list: Outstanding Achievement Award 2021 (2022-10-26) for deployment of tracker planes; "Forward Endcap travels to Jülich" (2023-04-24)
intervals.note: PANDA's own pages say the experiment "will be one of the key experiments" at FAIR, which "is under construction", and that "a versatile detector will be build"; news items record hardware activity (tracker planes deployed, forward endcap shipped), so construction is recorded from the earliest dated item. No source states a formal construction start or an operating date.

placements.note: Planned location at the FAIR site (campus-grade point); the detector is not yet operating.
placements.quote: The PANDA Experiment will be one of the key experiments at the Facility for Antiproton and Ion Research (FAIR) which is under construction and currently being built on the area of the GSI Helmholtzzentrum für Schwerionenforschung in Darmstadt, Germany.

summary.plain: A two-part detector around the antiproton beam: a solenoid-based target spectrometer surrounding the interaction point and a dipole forward spectrometer, for almost full solid-angle coverage with good particle identification.
summary.technical: PANDA: target spectrometer (solenoid around the interaction region) and forward spectrometer (dipole) with tracking, particle identification and electromagnetic calorimetry providing nearly full solid-angle coverage.

technology.quote: The proposed PANDA detector is a state-of-the art internal target detector at the HESR at FAIR
technology.value: Internal-target antiproton detector at the HESR with target and forward spectrometers
